channel.title: The Hindu National News
channel.description: National news coverage from The Hindu

item.title: ISRO successfully launches navigation satellite NVS-01 aboard GSLV rocket
item.description: The Indian Space Research Organisation has successfully placed the second-generation navigation satellite into geostationary transfer orbit from Sriharikota spaceport.

item.title: Union Cabinet approves national green hydrogen mission incentives
item.description: The Union Cabinet has sanctioned financial outlays for domestic electrolyser manufacturing and green hydrogen production hubs across five coastal states.

item.title: Supreme Court reserves judgment on inter-state river water sharing dispute
item.description: A three-judge bench concluded hearings on the allocation formula for surplus river flows during monsoon deficit seasons.
